description: Single full-body native pixel-art game sprite. IDENTITY MUST MATCH: Tall lean adult man with slightly slouched posture, long narrow pale face, pronounced dark under-eye shadows, tired half-lidded gray-brown eyes, small weary smile. LONG dark BROWN layered hair extending past shoulders, center part, long curved side locks and outward-flipped ends, untied. Navy suit, white shirt and navy tie. No mask. Relaxed upright SOUTH-facing stance, empty hands visible at sides, low top-down camera. Natural adult anatomy and normal torso/pelvis. Anatomical crown-to-sole height 230-238px on128x256, hair/cap excluded from body height. Soles at y248, leave unused space above shorter people, NEVER enlarge to fill canvas. Keep original individual body shape. Match style reference ONLY for crisp native1px clusters, selective dark outlines and controlled shading; own colors and clothes. Transparent background, no shadow, no text, no weapons. Entire hair and shoes inside frame.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY pixel rendering, outline, shading and lighting. Do not copy the reference male height, body shape, shoulder width, outfit or identity. Preserve this character own stature, build, age, hair, irises and original clothing colors and silhouette. FRONT view.
